task_completion.description: Agent opens Firefox Settings and navigates to the Certificates section.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshot shows Firefox 'Settings' or 'Preferences' page, specifically the 'Privacy & Security' tab or the 'Certificate Manager' dialog.

task_completion.description: Agent initiates the import of the certificate from the Downloads folder.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file picker dialog is visible showing 'corporate_root_ca.crt' being selected from the 'Downloads' directory.

task_completion.description: Agent checks the specific trust box during the import process.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Downloading Certificate' dialog is visible with the checkbox 'Trust this CA to identify websites' explicitly checked.

task_completion.description: Agent navigates to the internal HTTPS URL.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Firefox address bar shows 'https://internal.corp.local:8443' and the page begins to load.

task_completion.description: The website loads without a certificate warning/interstitial page.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The browser displays the IT policy content. There is a padlock icon in the address bar indicating a secure connection, and NO 'Warning: Potential Security Risk Ahead' screen is visible.

task_completion.description: Agent saves the specific heading text to the designated text file.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal command shows the content of '~/Documents/policy_focus.txt' containing the heading text from the IT policy webpage.

integrity.description: Agent did not click 'Accept the Risk and Continue' to bypass the certificate error.
integrity.visual_evidence: The trajectory must not show the agent clicking the 'Advanced' button followed by 'Accept the Risk and Continue' on a Firefox warning page.

integrity.description: Agent used the Firefox GUI to import the certificate rather than command-line NSS tools.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the Firefox Settings/Certificate Manager UI being used to import the .crt file.

integrity.description: The IT policy text was retrieved from the browser, not guessed.
integrity.visual_evidence: The text saved in policy_focus.txt matches the text visible on the rendered webpage at internal.corp.local:8443.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The internal site is located at https://internal.corp.local:8443. The certificate file is ~/Downloads/corporate_root_ca.crt. The task is only successful if the 'Trust this CA to identify websites' box is checked during import; otherwise, the browser will still show a security warning. The final output must be a file at ~/Documents/policy_focus.txt containing the main heading found on the webpage.
